question: With regard to hereditary breast cancer, point out the FALSE answer:

options.opa: It accounts for approximately 20% of all cases of breast cancer.
options.opb: It should be suspected in those families with several affected members.
options.opc: The known genetic alterations that cause hereditary breast cancer usually have an autosomal recessive inheritance.
options.opd: It may be indicated to perform a prophylactic mastectomy.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Hereditary breast cancer" -> "Accounts for approximately 20% of all cases of breast cancer" -> 100% CHAIN: "Hereditary breast cancer" -> "Should be suspected in families with several affected members" -> 100% CHAIN: "Hereditary breast cancer" -> "Known genetic alterations usually have an autosomal dominant inheritance" -> 90% CHAIN: "Hereditary breast cancer" -> "May be indicated to perform a prophylactic mastectomy" -> 20%
analysis: The statement 'The known genetic alterations that cause hereditary breast cancer usually have an autosomal recessive inheritance' is FALSE. In fact, the known genetic alterations associated with hereditary breast cancer usually have an autosomal dominant inheritance pattern.
